mfa_enforced_for_admin.title: MFA Enforced for Admin Access
mfa_enforced_for_admin.description: MFA mandatory for admin/privileged logins (CIS 6.5). Secure value is true.

mfa_enforced_for_vpn_login.title: MFA Enforced for VPN / Remote Login
mfa_enforced_for_vpn_login.description: MFA mandatory for remote/VPN access (CIS 6.4). Secure value is true.

mfa_enforced_for_externally_exposed_apps.title: MFA Enforced for Internet-Exposed Apps
mfa_enforced_for_externally_exposed_apps.description: MFA mandatory for internet-exposed enterprise apps (CIS 6.3). Secure value is true.

phishing_resistant_authenticator_require.title: Phishing-Resistant Authenticator Required
phishing_resistant_authenticator_require.description: Required authenticator strength for high-value access. Secure value is fido2_or_piv (origin-bound, phishing-resistant).

phishing_resistant_mfa_enabled.title: Phishing-Resistant MFA Available
phishing_resistant_mfa_enabled.description: Phishing-resistant MFA is available/enabled in the environment. Supporting context for the authenticator-strength facet.

weak_sms_voice_mfa_disabled.title: Weak SMS/Voice MFA Disabled
weak_sms_voice_mfa_disabled.description: SMS-OTP / voice removed as a permitted second factor for high-value accounts (SS7 / SIM-swap exposure). Secure value is true.

mfa_fail_closed.title: MFA Fails Closed
mfa_fail_closed.description: MFA fails closed on service error (no password-only fallback). Secure value is true.

legacy_auth_protocols_disabled.title: Legacy Auth Protocols Disabled
legacy_auth_protocols_disabled.description: Legacy/basic-auth protocols that skip modern MFA blocked tenant-wide. Secure value is true.

conditional_access_exclusions_minimized.title: Conditional-Access Exclusions Minimized
conditional_access_exclusions_minimized.description: CA exclusions restricted to one documented break-glass account. Secure value is true.

push_number_matching_enabled.title: Push Number-Matching Enabled
push_number_matching_enabled.description: Push MFA enforces number-matching so a user cannot blindly approve. Secure value is true.

push_request_rate_limiting_enabled.title: Push Request Rate-Limiting Enabled
push_request_rate_limiting_enabled.description: Push generation throttled per account with anomalous-prompt alerting (anti prompt-bombing). Secure value is true.

step_up_reauth_for_sensitive_actions.title: Step-Up Re-Auth for Sensitive Actions
step_up_reauth_for_sensitive_actions.description: Sensitive operations trigger a fresh MFA challenge. Secure value is true.

mfa_session_lifetime_bounded.title: MFA Session Lifetime Bounded
mfa_session_lifetime_bounded.description: Authenticated sessions carry an AAL-appropriate bounded lifetime plus reauthentication interval. Secure value is true.

session_idle_timeout_minutes.title: Session Idle Timeout (Minutes)
session_idle_timeout_minutes.description: Idle session timeout in minutes; <=30 is secure.

secure_mfa_enrollment_and_recovery.title: Secure MFA Enrollment & Recovery
secure_mfa_enrollment_and_recovery.description: Identity-proofed enrollment plus recovery re-establishes equivalent assurance (no weak KBA reset / unverified self-registration). Secure value is true.

mfa_authentication_events_audited.title: MFA Authentication Events Audited
mfa_authentication_events_audited.description: MFA sign-ins, factor registrations, denied/ignored prompts, and policy changes are logged and alerted. Secure value is true.
